name: CSV Schema Guard
target_user: Data analysts, database administrators, and spreadsheet users.
problem: Incoming CSV files frequently have malformed rows, mismatched column counts, encoding glitches, or inconsistent date formats that break database import scripts.
pain: Hours spent debugging cryptic database import errors or writing throwaway scripts to find a single rogue comma or unescaped quote in a 50,000-row file.
solution: A completely local browser application where users drop a CSV file to instantly get a visual audit map of structural anomalies, duplicate headers, type mismatches (e.g., text in a numeric column), and non-ASCII character highlights, with one-click repair and export.
verification: Load a mock CSV with variable column counts and mismatched data types in the browser, verify the UI highlights the exact row/column coordinates of the anomalies, and check that the exported CSV resolves those issues.
major_features: Interactive visual grid of formatting anomalies
Automatic column data-type inference and mismatch highlighting
Instant export of sanitized CSV files with encoding repairs
